SELECT 
  fished_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  ROUND(AVG(yt * 1.0 / anglers), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy >= 286 AND fished_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls

# Check October boat performance and class stats
import pandas as pd

oct_data = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] >= 286) & 
                           (tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] <= 297)]

# Group by boat and class
boat_stats = oct_data[oct_data['cls'] == 'DAY_1_5'].groupby('boat').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count'],
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).round(2)

boat_stats.columns = ['total_yt', 'trips', 'total_anglers']
boat_stats['yt_per_angler'] = (boat_stats['total_yt'] / boat_stats['total_anglers']).round(2)
boat_stats = boat_stats.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

result = f"Day_1_5 October peak boats (doy 286-297):\n{boat_stats.head(10)}"
print(result)
